plan.title: release:run (#6845 S4): enqueue reads, built-in waits and the merge phase

narratives.Description: After the up-front approval, the release PR still needs a hand-checked merge freeze, a manual watch and merge, and a manual finish (#6877, S4 of #6845). This story builds the merge phase of `deft release:run`: enqueue reads (origin tip still B and an empty merge queue), the in-process `pr:watch` wait, then `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge --wait`, one re-run of a failed required check per run kept in the run record, and the tag reconciliation the finish step needs on `--resume`. It builds clauses 7, 8, 18, 22, 23 and 25 of the accepted #6845 lean 7032154033 (split comment 7048165729); the S5 (#6878) clauses stay out.
narratives.Overview:
After the up-front approval, the release PR still needs a hand-checked merge freeze, a manual watch and merge, and a manual finish. This story adds the merge phase of `deft release:run` (#6845): enqueue reads, built-in waits with one re-run, and tag reconciliation on resume. In the clauses, B is the cut base (the fetched delivery-branch tip), T is the tree of the release commit and M is the merged release commit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Enqueue reads, no hold. The run enqueues the release PR only when the origin tip is still B and the merge queue is empty, and otherwise stops without enqueueing. After an ejection it re-enqueues only under the same reads. The finish step resolves the sole parent of M and refuses unless it is B, before it creates the tag and before it pushes a tag left only local; so when another PR lands ahead anyway, the run stops before the tag and names the break-glass recovery.
- [ ] Built-in waits. The run waits on the release PR in-process with `pr:watch` until CLEAN, then `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge --wait`. A failed required check, or a queue ejection for a failed check, is re-run once per run; the count is kept in the run record and `--resume` does not reset it. A second failure or a review finding stops the run.
- [ ] Given an origin tip that is not B or a non-empty merge queue, when the run would enqueue the release PR, then it does not enqueue and stops.
- [ ] Given a crash after the local tag on M and before its push, when `--resume` runs, then it pushes the tag and continues.
- [ ] Given a remote `v<version>` tag on a commit other than M, when `--resume` runs, then it stops.
- [ ] Given a required check that fails once, then the run re-runs it once; given a second failure, also after a `--resume`, then the run stops without another re-run.

Refs #6845

narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want `deft release:run` to enqueue the release PR only while the cut base is still the tip and the queue is empty, to wait on the PR and the queue itself, to re-run a failed required check once, and to finish a tag a crash left only local, so that after the up-front mint I no longer check the freeze, watch, merge or finish by hand.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/release/run-merge.ts: the merge phase. Wait on the release PR in-process with the pr:watch engine until CLEAN; read the origin tip (must be B) and the merge queue (must be empty) before every enqueue, else stop without enqueueing; then run the pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge engine with --wait. A failed required check (CI_BLOCKED) or a queue ejection for a failed check uses the one re-run of the run (gh run rerun --failed for the failed Actions runs, or a re-enqueue under the same reads); a second failure or a review finding (NEW_P0_P1) stops (clauses 1, 2, 3, 6).
2. packages/core/src/release/run-record.ts: keep the re-run count and the enqueue head and time in the run record; --resume never resets the count; records without the fields read as zero and none (clauses 2, 6).
3. packages/core/src/release/finish.ts: under the run binding, after the parent-of-M check, read the local and remote v<version> tag. A tag only local that peels to M is pushed (after the run-bound gate); a remote tag that peels to M is done; a tag on any other commit stops and nothing is overwritten (clauses 1, 4, 5).
4. packages/core/src/release/run.ts: the merge phase calls run-merge.ts; help text names the reads, the waits and the re-run.
5. Colocated vitest suites (run-merge.test.ts, finish-run-tag.test.ts, run.test.ts, run-record.test.ts) and changelog fragment changelog.d/6877-release-run-merge.md.
